newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends mixed ahead of new Canadian quota.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends mixed ahead of new Canadian quota.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed mixed after a lightly traded session.
Nearby May closed higher while deferred contracts ended slightly lower.

Analysts and traders had no consensus on how much lumber Canada will ship into the U.S. when its next quarterly shipping quota becomes effective Tuesday. One analyst expected shipments from eastern Canadian mills to rise slightly while shipments from western mills hold steady.

Sharply lower U.S. stock markets and lower bond markets lent a bearish tone to deferred lumber futures. Late Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Index was down 168 points, while Treasury bond futures closed slightly lower.
Lumber futures closed up $2.00 to down $3.20 with May the lone gainer at $380.50.
